title: Practice 16: Irregular comparatives: лучше, больше, старше

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Bologne is closer to Florence than Milan.
exercises.why: "старее" and "более старый" are comparative forms from "старый". — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–82.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: "старее" and "более старый" are comparative forms from "старый".
